scope: Normalized 'professional_players' national-page observations from FIFA Professional Football Report 2023.
limitations: Missing national-page values remain absent rather than zero. Extracted national sums differ from FIFA's published global headline and both are preserved. One source page is labelled KUWAIT while showing Kyrgyzstan visual identity; that observation is preserved with an explicit identity-anomaly flag and is not automatically reassigned. Association-to-Earth identity mapping is separate.
